title: First Doctor Check-up
desc: Your first official visit to the doctor — weighed, measured, and declared perfectly healthy.
story: Six weeks in, we bundled you up and headed to the clinic for your first proper check-up. The doctor checked your eyes, hips, reflexes, and heart, all while you stared at the ceiling light with great seriousness. Growing beautifully, feeding well, and absolutely thriving. We drove home feeling like we must be doing something right.
